review.notes: Full review of the 257-line change since c6526d1 and of the whole roadmap. The previous review's one blocking finding (R01: AA.2.4 restated LFunctions' finite-order Hecke continuation and nonvanishing) is repaired: the target, the theorem and its two imports are deleted and every passage now consumes LFunctions layers 5 and 7 by name; all seven cited names (heckeLFunctionC, eulerCorrection, heckeLFunctionC_eq, heckeLFunctionC_induced, heckeLFunctionC_eq_primitive, differentiable_completedHeckeLFunction, heckeLFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re) resolve at LFunctions' open head with the hypotheses the README uses, and LFunctions (order line 23) is above this roadmap (line 30). Gate re-run: OK; movable dependency check: 201 roadmaps, 1319 edges, 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE/moved line. lake env lean on Suggested.lean: 20 sorry warnings, nothing else; one-tactic probe (rfl/simp/infer_instance/exact?) closes none of the 20 theorems; #check of all 62 declarations compared with the README; the six dropped-binder leads are genuine non-uses. Source sample: all 15 seeded targets read at their locators in the cache (Borel, Conrad, Sutherland, Rosengarten, Arthur, Borel-Tits, BKT and erratum, Orr, Milne, LT, Khayutin, CG, Loeffler), plus the Mathlib and Tau Ceti declarations they cite by file and line; PRR, PR94, BHC, Voight, Schneider paywalled. Adversarial table: 36 rows with computed values, including the non-unimodular direction of finite_volume_iff and the new Q(sqrt(-5)) induction Check. Two P3 notes: the Weyl-orbit bullet of AA.1.5 cites Borel 5.5, which contains no such statement (Borel-Tits 5.3 does), and one sentence of the new change-of-presentation paragraph says both sides of the Artin-Hecke identity change. Ownership: Tamagawa measure, neat levels and the Artin local factors have no other owner among the readable roadmaps; the quaternion norm image is also built over Q in the open OrthogonalSpinGroups pull request, which is not in the merge order, so this roadmap owns the general statement.
